# Dimension

The dimension foundation — direct `space` · `size` · `radius` · `ratio` · `border` leaves authored in the dimension SoT. Pixel dimensions emit `Npx` (with `0` unitless), ratios emit bare numbers, and `radius.full` remains the 9999px pill sentinel. One value, both targets.

| Token | Cascade | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space.none` | `literal` | `0` |
| `space.xs` | `literal` | `3px` |
| `space.sm` | `literal` | `6px` |
| `space.md` | `literal` | `12px` |
